about: 30 requests for UMC301 Project 5, written before building. Each task names roles (what must be in the scene) and machine-checkable checks. The checker binds scene objects to roles by kind + colour, so the agent may name objects anything.

conventions.units: metres, seconds; scene fps from the agent (default 24)
conventions.directions: left / right / toward / away are camera-relative, judged from the final camera at the frame the check refers to
conventions.colours: a colour name matches if the object's base colour is closest (in hue) to that name among: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, white, black, grey, brown
conventions.figure_actions: action names match the motion library; 'walk' matches walk, walk_happy, walk_sad, walk_worried; a mood walk (walk_sad, …) only matches itself

check_types.count: {role, n}: exactly n objects match the role
check_types.in_view: role(s) inside the camera frame (≥ 90% of the projected bounds) on the given frames; 'most' = at least 75% of frames (things may enter or leave)
check_types.not_hidden: camera ray casts reach the role on the given frames
check_types.on_surface: {role, surface}: role rests on surface (role or 'ground'), ±1 cm; checked at the last frame unless 'frame' given
check_types.row: {roles, order}: roles lie on one line, roughly evenly spaced (±25%), in this left→right order
check_types.relation: {a, rel, b}: rel ∈ left_of, right_of, next_to (gap ≤ 0.5 m), on_top_of, in_front_of, behind; at the last frame
check_types.bounces: {role, n, surface}: n local height minima touching the surface
check_types.spins: {role, turns, axis, seconds}: total rotation = turns × 360° (±10%) within seconds (±20%)
check_types.moves: {role, direction, min_m}: net displacement in that camera-relative direction ≥ min_m
check_types.scale_change: {role, from, to}: scale factor at start / end (±10%)
check_types.colour_change: {role, from, to}: base colour at start / end
check_types.camera_move: {kind, target}: kind ∈ orbit (≥ 90° around target), dolly_in (distance to target falls ≥ 20%), follow (target stays within the middle third), pan
check_types.grounded: lowest foot point within ±1 cm of the floor on contact frames, never below it
check_types.no_pops: no joint speed above max_speed_ratio × that action's median speed at action boundaries
check_types.staging: angle between the camera view and the current action's motion plane ≤ max_angle_deg
check_types.actions_in_order: {role, actions}: these actions appear in the figure's timeline in this order (others may be between)
check_types.action_duration: {role, action, min_s, max_s}: total time spent in that action
check_types.speed: {role, action, relative}: relative ∈ slow (speed ≤ 0.85), normal, fast (≥ 1.2), from play_action's speed
check_types.reaches: {role, target, within_m, facing}: figure stops within_m of the target, optionally facing it
check_types.faces: {a, b}: at the last frame a's forward direction points at b (±30°)
check_types.returns: {role, within_m}: figure ends within within_m of where it started, after moving ≥ 1 m away
check_types.same_time: {roles, action}: the roles perform the action in overlapping time ranges
check_types.no_collision: no two roles' bounds overlap on any frame (figures vs props, figures vs figures)
check_types.middle_of_row: {role, row}: role is the middle object of that row
check_types.distance_end: {a, b, min_m, max_m}: distance between a and b at the last frame
check_types.start_near: {role, target, within_m}: figure starts within within_m of target; 'boxes.left' / 'boxes.right' = leftmost / rightmost match of a role, camera-relative
check_types.passes: {role, target}: the figure starts on one side of the target and ends on the other (camera-relative)
check_types.in_view (region): optional 'region': 'middle_third' requires the role's centre in the middle third of the frame

tasks.request: three cubes in a row, the middle one blue
a red ball on a table, with a chair next to the table
a lamp on a table and a green box on the floor to the left of the table, in sunset light
a red ball bounces three times on the floor
a cube spins around once in 2 seconds
a yellow ball rolls from left to right across a table and drops onto the floor
a blue sphere grows from nothing to full size, then turns red
the camera slowly orbits around a table with a ball on it
a stick man walks to the right for 4 seconds
a stick figure waves at the camera
a stick figure stands still, just breathing, for 3 seconds
a sad stick figure walks slowly to the left
a happy stick woman walks from the left side of the screen to the right
a red stick figure gets a sudden fright
a stick man walks in from the left, stops in the middle and waves
she walks in, stops, looks down, then walks away sadly
a stick figure stands around, gets startled, then hurries off to the right
a stick man walks to the right, turns around and walks back to where he started
a worried stick figure walks a few steps, stops, and looks down for 2 seconds
she waves at the camera, then walks off happily to the left
a stick man walks to the table and waves
a stick figure walks up to a chair with a ball on it and looks down at the ball
she walks around a big box to reach the tree behind it
a red ball sits on a table; a stick figure walks up to it, gets a fright and walks back
two boxes stand on the floor; a stick man walks from the left box to the right box
a stick figure walks past a tree while the camera follows him
two stick figures walk toward each other and stop face to face; the camera slowly dollies in
a red and a blue stick figure stand side by side and wave together
one stick man waves, and the other one walks over to him
two stick figures walk side by side from left to right, and the camera follows them
